symptom: pylint 2.17.4 with astroid 2.15.5 crashes ('Fatal error while checking', astroid-error F0002) when a class uses a metaclass whose own base list contains duplicates (e.g. class Meta(type(object), type(object))): computing the metaclass MRO in _is_invalid_metaclass raises astroid.exceptions.DuplicateBasesError, which escapes instead of being handled. Fixed in the pylint 3.x series (no crash on pylint 3.0.3).
